title: Aha
summary: 'AH'A. 1. An exclamation expressing triumph, contempt, or simple surprise; but the senses are distinguished by very different modes of utterance, and different modification of features. 2. A sunk fenc

inlines.v: 'AH'A. 1. An exclamation expressing triumph, contempt, or simple surprise; but the senses are distinguished by very different modes of utterance, and different modification of features. 2. A sunk fence, not visible, without near approach.
